description: Add a text overlay for a time range (seconds, 0.1s steps, at least 1s). At most 8.

animation.description: How it comes on: none, fade, pop or slide-up.

color.description: Text color as a hex code, like #FFFFFF.

endSeconds.description: When the text disappears, in seconds; at least 1 s after startSeconds.

fontId.description: Font: dm-sans, tenor-sans, montserrat, space-grotesk or ibm-plex-mono.

placement.description: Where it sits on screen: top, center or lower.

size.description: Text size: small, medium or large.

startSeconds.description: When the text appears, in seconds from the start (0.1 s steps).

text.description: The words to show, up to 120 characters.

name: add_text
title: Add text
